scope: Ability badges, colon glyph, starting loyalty plate, frame outline and four-row spacing using existing assets. 26 previously examined cards are development; 44 M15/WAR cards are reserved transfer. Original-printing text, ordinary treatments only.
limitations: Printing-reference wording is not automatically scan-certified.
Texture and small scan registration differences affect structural metrics.
Teferi art variants share a text layout and are not independent typographic validation.
Body-region results do not establish whole-card accuracy.
The badge assets contain a baked shadow; an added soft shadow cannot completely change that source artwork.
A narrow colon strip reduces text contamination but still includes separator/background edges.
A full-card art crop is not supplied for the translucent planeswalker paper; paper texture and underlying illustration remain asset/composition limitations.

alignment.profile: Frozen M21 frame-family transform, existing M20 transfer, and explicitly unvalidated M15/WAR transfer. Raw metrics retained.

lines: Until end of turn, up to one target creature gets
+1/+1 and gains first strike, vigilance, and
lifelink.\r
Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
and a loyalty counter on each other planeswalker
you control.\r
You get an emblem with "If a source would deal
damage to you or a planeswalker you control,
prevent all but 1 of that damage."
Look at the top two cards of your library.
Put one of them into your graveyard.\r
Return another target nonland permanent
to its owner's hand.\r
Each player shuffles his or her hand and
graveyard into his or her library. You draw
seven cards.
Target player discards a card.\r
Search your library for a card, then shuffle
your library and put that card on top of
it.\r
Put all creature cards from all graveyards
onto the battlefield under your control.
Chandra, Pyromaster deals 1 damage to target player
and 1 damage to up to one target creature that
player controls. That creature can't block this turn.\r
Exile the top card of your library. You may play it
this turn.\r
Exile the top ten cards of your library. Choose an
instant or sorcery card exiled this way and copy it
three times. You may cast the copies without paying
their mana costs.
Target land you control becomes a 4/4
Elemental creature with trample. It's still a
land.\r
Untap up to four target Forests.\r
Search your library for any number of basic land
cards, put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle
your library. Those lands become 4/4 Elemental
creatures with trample. They're still lands.
Destroy another target planeswalker.\r
Put a 3/3 black Beast creature token with
deathtouch onto the battlefield.\r
Destroy target creature. You gain life equal to
its toughness.\r
Target opponent gets an emblem with
"Whenever a creature attacks you, it gets
+5/+5 and gains trample until end of turn."
Activated abilities of artifacts your opponents control
can't be activated.
Until your next turn, up to one target
noncreature artifact becomes an artifact creature
with power and toughness each equal to its
converted mana cost.
You may choose an artifact card you own from
outside the game or in exile, reveal that card, and
put it into your hand.
Colorless spells you cast cost {2} less to cast.
Exile the top card of your library face down
and look at it. Create a 2/2 colorless Spirit
creature token. When that token leaves the
battlefield, put the exiled card into your hand.
Destroy target permanent that's one or more
colors.
As long as it's your turn, Gideon Blackblade is a
4/4 Human Soldier creature with indestructible
that's still a planeswalker.
Prevent all damage that would be dealt to Gideon
Blackblade during your turn.
Up to one other target creature you control
gains your choice of vigilance, lifelink, or
indestructible until end of turn.
Exile target nonland permanent.
You have hexproof. (You can't be the target of
spells or abilities your opponents control.)
Create a 0/3 white Wall creature token
with defender.
Prevent all noncombat damage that would be
dealt to you and other permanents you
control.
Exile target creature with power 4 or
greater.
If you would draw a card while your library
has no cards in it, you win the game instead.
Target player puts the top two cards of
their library into their graveyard. Draw a
card.
Draw seven cards. Then if your library has
no cards in it, you win the game.
Spells your opponents cast that target a
creature or planeswalker you control cost {2}
more to cast.
Create a 2/2 blue Wizard creature token.
Draw a card, then discard a card.
Each opponent can't draw more than one
card each turn.
Look at the top four cards of your library.
You may reveal a noncreature, nonland
card from among them and put it into your
hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your
library in a random order.
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep,
if that player has one or fewer cards in hand,
Davriel, Rogue Shadowmage deals 2 damage
to them.
Target player discards a card.
Whenever a creature you control dies, draw a
card.
Create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
Each player sacrifices two creatures.
Each opponent chooses a permanent they
control of each permanent type and sacrifices
the rest.
Whenever an opponent draws a card, Ob
Nixilis, the Hate-Twisted deals 1 damage to
that player.
Destroy target creature. Its controller
draws two cards.
Whenever one or more loyalty counters are
removed from Chandra, Fire Artisan, she deals that
much damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
Exile the top card of your library. You may play
it this turn.
Exile the top seven cards of your library. You
may play them this turn.
If another red source you control would deal
damage to a permanent or player, it deals that
much damage plus 1 to that permanent or
player instead.
Jaya, Venerated Firemage deals 2 damage
to any target.
Whenever a creature attacks you or a
planeswalker you control, each Dragon you
control deals 1 damage to that creature.
Until end of turn, each planeswalker you
control becomes a 4/4 red Dragon creature
and gains flying.
Create a 4/4 red Dragon creature token with
flying.
Your opponents can't gain life.
Create a 1/1 red Devil creature token with
"When this creature dies, it deals 1 damage
to any target."
Each creature you control that's a Wolf or a
Werewolf enters the battlefield with an
additional +1/+1 counter on it.
Create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token.
Each creature you control with a +1/+1
counter on it has "{T}: Add one mana of any
color."
Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
Whenever you tap a Forest for mana, add an additional {G}.
Put three +1/+1 counters on up to one target noncreature
land you control. Untap it. It becomes a 0/0 Elemental
creature with vigilance and haste that's still a land.
You get an emblem with "Lands you control have
indestructible." Search your library for any number of
Forest cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then
shuffle your library.
You may cast creature spells as though they had flash.
Until your next turn, up to one target creature gains
vigilance and reach.
Look at the top three cards of your library. Exile
one face down and put the rest on the bottom of
your library in any order. For as long as it remains
exiled, you may look at that card and you may cast
it if it's a creature card.
Creatures you control have vigilance.
You gain 3 life.
Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you
control and a loyalty counter on each other
planeswalker you control.
Creatures you control get +1/+0.
Add {R} or {G}. Creature spells you cast this
turn can't be countered.
Target creature you control fights target
creature you don't control.
Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God has all loyalty abilities
of all other planeswalkers on the battlefield.
You draw a card. Each opponent exiles a
card from their hand or a permanent they
control.
Destroy target creature or planeswalker.
Each opponent who doesn't control a
legendary creature or planeswalker loses the
game.
Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery
spell, Ral, Storm Conduit deals 1 damage to
target opponent or planeswalker.
Scry 1.
When you cast your next instant or sorcery
spell this turn, copy that spell. You may
choose new targets for the copy.
As long as it's your turn, creatures and
planeswalkers you control have lifelink.
Sorin, Vengeful Bloodlord deals 1 damage to
target player or planeswalker.
Return target creature card with converted
mana cost X from your graveyard to the
battlefield. That creature is a Vampire in
addition to its other types.
Spells and abilities your opponents control can't
cause you to discard cards or sacrifice permanents.
Choose a nonland card name, then reveal the
top four cards of your library. Put all cards with
the chosen name from among them into your
hand and the rest into your graveyard.
Return target card from your graveyard to your
hand.
Each opponent can cast spells only any time
they could cast a sorcery.
Until your next turn, you may cast sorcery
spells as though they had flash.
Return up to one target artifact, creature,
or enchantment to its owner's hand. Draw
a card.
Creatures you control have menace.
Amass 2. (Put two +1/+1 counters on an
Army you control. If you don't control one,
create a 0/0 black Zombie Army creature
token first.)
Spells and abilities your opponents control
can't cause their controller to search their
library.
Target player puts the top four cards of
their library into their graveyard. Then
exile each opponent's graveyard.
Artifact, instant, and sorcery spells your
opponents cast cost {1} more to cast.
Until your next turn, prevent all damage
that would be dealt to and dealt by target
permanent an opponent controls.
Each creature you control assigns combat
damage equal to its toughness rather than its
power.
You gain life equal to the greatest
toughness among creatures you control.
Your opponents and permanents your
opponents control with hexproof can be the
targets of spells and abilities you control as
though they didn't have hexproof.
Exile target creature.
Whenever a creature with power 4 or greater
enters the battlefield under your control,
draw a card.
Untap target permanent.
As long as it's your turn, creatures you
control have first strike and equip abilities
you activate cost {1} less to activate.
Nahiri, Storm of Stone deals X damage to
target tapped creature.
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create
a 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.
Target artifact you control becomes a copy
of another target artifact or creature you
control until end of turn, except it's an
artifact in addition to its other types.
Creatures you control have haste.
Target creature gets +2/+1 and gains haste
until end of turn. Scry 1.
Whenever a creature you control with
deathtouch deals damage to a player or
planeswalker, put a +1/+1 counter on that
creature.
Create a 1/1 black Assassin creature token
with deathtouch and "Whenever this
creature deals damage to a planeswalker,
destroy that planeswalker."
Whenever you attack with two or more non-Gideon
creatures, put a +1/+1 counter on each of those
creatures.
Until end of turn, Gideon, the Oathsworn becomes a
5/5 white Soldier creature that's still a planeswalker.
Prevent all damage that would be dealt to him this
turn. (He can't attack if he was cast this turn.)
Exile Gideon, the Oathsworn and each creature your
opponents control.
Whenever you draw your second card each turn,
put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you
control.
Draw a card.
Creatures you control can't be blocked this
turn.
